articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record as Largest Ever, Expands to Two Convention Center Buildings
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 made history as the largest gathering of the global attractions industry, spanning a record 630,000 square feet across two buildings at Orlando's Orange County Convention Center for the first time. The expanded footprint reflects strong industry growth and demand from suppliers and operators alike. FEC operators attending or tracking the show will find a wealth of new product launches, partnerships, and investment signals across the week.

articles.title: Triotech Launches Five New Attractions at IAAPA Expo 2026 — Largest Product Release in Company History
articles.summary: Montreal-based Triotech unveiled Electric Funfair, Energize!, SuperMover, Typhoon Shockwave, and Krazy Karts at IAAPA Expo 2026, with worldwide ordering now open and delivery slated for Q2 2027. The release represents the biggest single product launch in the company's history and signals major investment in FEC-ready interactive and immersive attractions. Operators looking to refresh or expand their attraction mix heading into 2027 should take note of the breadth of formats available.

articles.title: 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Best Exhibit and Best New Product Award Winners Announced
articles.summary: The Brass Ring Awards, among the most prestigious honors in the attractions industry, recognized standout exhibitors and new products at IAAPA Expo 2026. Winners serve as a reliable shortlist for FEC operators scouting the most innovative and market-ready products on the show floor. Tracking these awards each year is a useful way to identify which suppliers are leading in product development.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Debuts BumbleBee Transformers VR Motion Simulator at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: DOF Robotics unveiled BumbleBee, a 360-degree VR motion simulator themed to the Transformers franchise in partnership with Hasbro, at its largest-ever IAAPA booth. The attraction is built on DOF's proven Hurricane platform but features exclusive Transformers content and a redesigned exterior, making it a turnkey IP-driven experience for FEC operators. The booth earned recognition in the Brass Ring Best Exhibit awards for the second consecutive year.

articles.title: Disney Unveils Autonomous AI-Powered Animatronic Characters That Interact with Guests Without Puppeteering
articles.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering R&D revealed three AI-driven Anzellan animatronics powered by Amazon Web Services that can perceive guests in real time and respond naturally without any live operator control. The technology represents a significant leap in autonomous guest interaction and could foreshadow next-generation character experiences across themed entertainment venues. FEC operators and attraction suppliers should watch this development closely as the underlying technology matures toward broader commercial deployment.

articles.title: RWS Global Outlines Top Experiential Trends Shaping Live Entertainment in 2027
articles.summary: RWS Global's Jake McCoy highlights consumer demand for deeper emotional engagement, stronger value perception, and memorable shared experiences as the dominant forces heading into 2027. The insights are drawn from work with major global entertainment brands and underscore the continued growth of the experience economy. FEC operators can use these trends to benchmark their own programming and guest experience strategies for the coming year.

articles.title: Alterface Showcases Ultra-Low Latency Interactive Technology at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Alterface presented its newest interactive attraction technology at IAAPA Expo 2026, featuring ultra-low 30-millisecond latency and high-precision tracking for highly responsive guest interactions. The system also gives designers greater creative freedom in building interactive dark rides and shooting attractions. For FEC operators investing in interactive ride experiences, the technology upgrade could meaningfully improve guest satisfaction scores.

articles.title: ProSlide Commits $15 Million R&D Investment to Next-Generation Water Attraction Technology
articles.summary: ProSlide has announced a $15 million investment in research and development targeting advances in water coasters, PowerRAPIDS river systems, and immersive water slide technology. The commitment signals strong confidence in the water attraction market and positions ProSlide to deliver more sophisticated products to waterparks and FECs with water features. Operators planning capital improvements to aquatic offerings should track the pipeline of innovations this investment will generate.

articles.title: WhiteWater Presents Nine New Projects Across Six Venue Types at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: WhiteWater, the world's largest water attraction designer and supplier, showcased nine recently opened or upcoming projects spanning theme parks, resorts, cruise lines, and other venue types at its IAAPA Expo 2026 press conference. The breadth of venue types illustrated how water features are becoming anchor attractions across diverse entertainment destinations. FEC operators considering water-based additions will find WhiteWater's expanded portfolio increasingly relevant.

articles.title: Red Raion Creating Power Rangers Media Content for 5D, VR, Dome, and Flying Theater Attractions
articles.summary: Red Raion has partnered with Hasbro to develop media-based attraction content featuring the Power Rangers IP, available across 5D theaters, VR experiences, dome theaters, and flying theaters. The licensing deal expands the pool of proven IP-driven content options available to FEC operators running simulator or theater attractions. For venues seeking fresh turnkey content to drive repeat visits, Power Rangers-branded experiences could offer strong family appeal.

articles.title: RES Rides Unveils SKYLINER Cable Car System and Interactive Vertical Dark Ride at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: RES Rides debuted two new attraction concepts at IAAPA Expo 2026: the SKYLINER, a next-generation transportable cable car designed for fairs and leisure destinations, and an Interactive Vertical Dark Ride that evolves its award-winning attraction platform. Both concepts offer operators flexible, scalable options for adding distinctive guest experiences. The transportable nature of the SKYLINER in particular opens opportunities for seasonal or event-based FEC programming.

articles.title: Zamperla and Cacau Show Group Partner on WINGZ Interactive Family Attraction for New Brazil Theme Park
articles.summary: Zamperla will supply multiple rides, including the new WINGZ interactive family flight attraction, for Cacau Park, a theme park under development near São Paulo, Brazil, scheduled to open in 2027. The partnership highlights growing investment in family entertainment destinations across Latin America. FEC operators can look to WINGZ as an example of the interactive family ride formats generating interest at IAAPA Expo 2026.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Introduces Patented Camera-Based Rider Safety Technology for FEC Venues
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, makers of a waterless surfing attraction designed for FECs and leisure venues, has launched newly patented camera-based safety technology that continuously monitors riders and automatically stops equipment if a fall is detected. The system also verifies that protective gear is properly worn before a session begins, reducing operator liability and improving guest confidence. The innovation addresses one of the key operational concerns for active ride attractions in family entertainment settings.

articles.title: Two FEC Properties Listed for Sale Through IRM, Including Texas Mid-Sized FEC Outlaw Pass
articles.summary: Investment and brokerage firm IRM is seeking qualified buyers for two family park properties, including Outlaw Pass, a mid-sized FEC in Texas described as having room to grow in its market. The dual listing represents an acquisition opportunity for operators or investors looking to expand their FEC portfolio. Interested parties should move quickly given that turnkey FEC properties with established infrastructure are relatively rare on the open market.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park to Open New Location in San Antonio
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide park concept, is expanding with a new location in San Antonio, Texas, continuing the brand's national rollout. The chain's growth reflects sustained consumer demand for active, family-focused indoor entertainment beyond traditional trampoline parks. FEC operators should take note of Slick City's expansion pace as a signal of competitive pressure in the indoor active entertainment segment.

articles.title: Indoor Slide Park with 25-Foot Slides Opening in Boise Next Month
articles.summary: A new indoor park featuring 25-foot slides is set to open in Boise, Idaho, next month, adding another active indoor entertainment option to a growing market. The opening reflects the broader national trend of slide-based indoor parks competing alongside trampoline parks and traditional FECs for family spending. Local FEC operators in the Pacific Northwest should anticipate this new format as an emerging competitive category.

articles.title: Slick City Confirms Boise Location Opening on Milwaukee Street
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park has confirmed it will open a new location in Boise, Idaho, on Milwaukee Street, further expanding its footprint in the western United States. The brand's continued growth underscores the indoor slide park format's appeal as a differentiated family entertainment option. FEC operators in the region should monitor how the new venue affects traffic patterns at nearby facilities.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has opened a new center in Denton, Texas, expanding the brand's presence in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. The opening adds another competitive venue to one of the country's most active FEC markets. Operators in the region will want to evaluate the new location's attraction mix and pricing as a benchmark.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun Overhauling Attractions at Seminole Towne Center FEC Location
articles.summary: Elev8 Fun is undertaking a significant overhaul of attractions at its Seminole Towne Center location in Florida, signaling a reinvestment strategy to keep the venue competitive. Attraction refreshes at mall-based FECs are increasingly important as operators compete with new indoor entertainment formats entering the market. The move is a useful case study for other mall-based FEC operators considering how to revitalize aging attraction lineups.

articles.title: Former Supermarket in Fort Wayne Being Converted Into Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket building in Fort Wayne, Indiana, is being repurposed as an indoor slide park, illustrating the growing trend of adaptive reuse of large retail spaces for family entertainment. Converting vacant big-box and grocery retail locations into FECs continues to gain momentum as commercial real estate costs and availability create new opportunities. This project is a practical example for operators and developers evaluating non-traditional venue footprints.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street Eyed for Indoor Entertainment Venue Conversion
articles.summary: A commercial property at 3002 Dodge Street in Omaha, Nebraska, is being considered for redevelopment as an indoor entertainment venue, reflecting ongoing demand for FEC-style destinations in mid-sized Midwest markets. The proposal highlights the continued interest from developers in converting underutilized retail or commercial real estate into experiential entertainment spaces. FEC operators and investors tracking market expansion opportunities in the Midwest should follow this development.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester as City Centre Builds Indoor Entertainment Cluster
articles.summary: Leicester's city centre has welcomed the UK's first human claw machine attraction, part of a broader clustering of indoor entertainment venues making the area a destination for experiential leisure. The novel format represents a category of low-footprint, highly shareable novelty attractions that can complement larger FEC offerings. Operators looking for affordable, social-media-friendly add-on experiences should take note of this format's growing traction.

articles.title: Madison County Approves TIF Funding Path for 'The Gallery' Mixed-Use Entertainment Development
articles.summary: Madison County, Mississippi, has paved the way for Tax Increment Financing to support 'The Gallery', a mixed-use development that includes retail, dining, and entertainment components. TIF mechanisms are an increasingly common tool for funding FEC-anchored developments, reducing upfront capital burden on operators and developers. FEC operators and investors evaluating public-private partnership models for new venues should monitor how this project structures its financing.

articles.title: Dippin' Dots Launches Strawberry Shortcake Limited-Edition Flavor for Spring 2027 FEC and Venue Partners
articles.summary: Dippin' Dots is introducing a limited-time Strawberry Shortcake Ice Cream flavor for spring 2027, available in bulk for franchisees and entertainment venues starting early 2027. Limited-time flavors are a proven driver of incremental F&B revenue at FECs by creating urgency and encouraging repeat visits. Operators who carry Dippin' Dots should consider pre-ordering to capitalize on the seasonal promotion.

articles.title: Six Retail Principles From European Theme Parks That FEC Operators Can Apply to Boost Secondary Spend
articles.summary: An industry analysis drawing on visits to theme parks across Europe identifies six tried-and-tested retail and merchandise principles that drive secondary spend and enhance guest loyalty. The piece covers tactics including hero product showcasing, location strategy, and merchandise as organic marketing, with real-world photo examples from major European parks. FEC operators looking to grow per-capita revenue beyond admissions will find actionable takeaways applicable at a range of venue scales.

articles.title: New Multi-Activity Indoor Entertainment Venue Coming to Amble, UK
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue offering a range of activities is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, expanding access to FEC-style experiences in a smaller UK coastal town. The opening reflects the continued spread of indoor entertainment venues into secondary and tertiary markets beyond major urban centres. Suppliers and franchise operators targeting underserved regional markets should track openings like this for expansion intelligence.

articles.title: 2027 Thea Award Recipients Announced by Themed Entertainment Association
articles.summary: The Themed Entertainment Association has announced the recipients of the 2027 Thea Awards, to be presented at the 33rd Annual Thea Awards Gala on April 3 as part of TEA INSPIRE 2027. The Thea Awards recognize excellence and innovation across the global themed entertainment industry, honoring projects and individuals shaping the guest experience landscape. FEC operators and suppliers tracking industry benchmarks should review the recipient list for emerging design and technology standards.
